name: mod-file-tree
description: A sidebar tree of the files Claude touched this session, marked read, edited, written or created, with the current one lit while Claude works. A replay steps through the last turn's edits, one diff at a time. Opens from /mod-file-tree or the Files pill in mod-menu

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when the terminal's font is a Nerd Font (read from Windows Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, GNOME Terminal or Konsole) and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one

show_reads.title: Show files Claude only read
show_reads.description: Read files join the changed ones. Off, it lists only changed files

wrap_diff.title: Wrap long diff lines
wrap_diff.description: Replay lines wrap onto the next row. Off, they are cut at the pane edge

recent_turns.title: Recent view (turns)
recent_turns.description: How many latest turns to cover. The middle view shows them, from 2 to 20
